rows.DXT_TEXT: MP2 Vendors are a unique combination of two 15 character vendor fields. The Infor EAM vendor is one 30 character field. Indicate how to convert MP2 Vendor and Vendor Branch into Infor EAM.
Select the appropriate Destination Organization for the follow areas of MP2. Your Destination Organization options will be based on your answer in Step 1.

The MP2 Equipment Priority field is a numeric field that can hold many different values. In Infor EAM the equipment criticality field is a field which users have to select from a valid equipment criticality. Select how to convert MP2 equipment priorities.
This is the end.

MP2 Locations are a unique combination of four 30 character location fields. The Infor EAM Location is one 30 character field that can have an infinite amount of levels. Indicate how to convert MP2 Location, Sub-location 1, Sub-location 2, and Sub-location 3 into Infor EAM.

MP2 allows the same meter name for multiple pieces of equipment. In Infor EAM each piece of equipment must have a unique 20 character meter name. Indicate how to convert MP2 Equipment Meters into Infor EAM.
Select to convert Employee records during the conversion process and select how the Employee records will be converted.

Select the MP2 User Defined Fields that you wish to convert. By selecting the User Defined Field, the conversion process will create the field in Infor EAM and convert the data that resides in that field in MP2.

For each Source Role, select a Destination Group. The selected Group will replace the Role in the destination database when converting users and the Site Role Assignments. If the Role conversion is skipped, then all the users that are converted will receive system administrator rights that can be updated after conversion.

For each Source Site, select a Destination Organization. The selected Organization will replace the Source Site in the destination database. Your selection here will increase or limit your selection of additional options.
Prior to running the conversion process, the following items should be completed to ensure a successful conversion.

MP2 Tasks are a unique combination of the 15 character Site field and the 20 character Task field. Infor EAM is one 20 character PM Schedule or Standard Work Order field that does not use the Infor EAM organization as part of the primary key. Indicate how to convert MP2 Tasks into Infor EAM. All MP2 Tasks with Equipment will become PM Schedules and all MP2 Tasks without Equipment will become Standard Work Orders.
Select the Infor EAM organization to link the MP2 Warehouse.

The MP2 Work Order Priority field is a numeric field that can hold many different values. In Infor EAM the work order priority field is a field which users have to select from a valid priority. Select how to convert MP2 work order priorities. This will only affect the Task conversion work order priorities.

For each Source Work Order Type select a Destination Work Order Type. The Destination Work Order Type will replace the Source Work Order Type in the destination database when converting the work order type list from MP2.
